name: Advent Mahjong 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Advent Mahjong is a match 3 Christmas-themed game to connect identical tiles and remove them from the grid to move on to the next challenging levels before you run out of time. By passing a level, you get one day closer to Christmas, and the closer you get the more challenging the levels are.
